components.caption: JetsnackButton — the gradient-filled primary action that defines the system's look.
JetsnackCard — the elevated surface every product tile is built on.
JetsnackSurface at rest — the primitive under every card, button and bar.
System divider.
Gradient-tinted icon button — the system's gradient tokens applied to an icon affordance.
The JetsnackColors palette as the app models it — brand, ui, text and icon roles, not M3 roles.
The seven gradient ramps plus tornado1. These are the signature of the system and have no Material 3 equivalent, so they appear nowhere in the @ThemeCatalog specimen sheets.
VerticalGrid — a custom Layout that divides width into equal columns and fills them column by column.
Product card as it appears in the feed.
The compact list form of a snack, used in the non-highlighted collections.
Circular product image. Under LocalInspectionMode the Coil request falls back to the shipped placeholder, so previews are deterministic and network-free.
A whole collection row in its highlighted form — the gradient-backed cards that scroll with a parallax offset.
Filter chip, enabled.
The filter row above the feed, with the filter-sheet trigger visible.
Quantity stepper.
A single cart line: image, name, price, remove affordance and the quantity stepper.
Order summary — subtotal, shipping and total, formatted through the sample's own formatPrice.
The swipe-to-remove affordance with its destructive background revealed.
Search entry field.
Category tile.
A single search result row.
Suggestion list shown before a query is entered, driven by SearchRepo.getSuggestions().
The empty state, which quotes the query back to the user.
Custom animated bottom navigation bar with Home selected — Jetsnack's signature chrome. The gradient selection pill makes the selected tab the only one showing its label.
A single nav item, selected: icon and label laid out side by side.
Delivery destination bar pinned above the feed.
JetsnackSnackbar — the M3 snackbar re-coloured onto uiBackground / textSecondary / brand.
The full app shell at its start destination: feed content, nested navigation, shared-transition scopes and bottom navigation together.
The home feed — destination bar, filter row and the full stack of snack collections. Renders at default, dark theme and fontScale 2.
The cart — order lines, summary and the checkout bar. Renders at default, dark theme and fontScale 2.
The search destination in its resting state, showing the category grid beneath the search bar.
Profile screen.
